Class CsvHighlightRepository

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.persistence.CsvHighlightRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
HighlightRepository
public final class CsvHighlightRepository extends Object implements HighlightRepository
Keeps highlights in a CSV file, so they outlive the process that captured them.

The file format is private to this class: no other class reads or writes it. Every call goes to the file, so two instances on the same path always agree.

  • Method Details

    • save

      public void save(Highlight highlight) throws RepositoryException
      Stores a highlight, replacing any earlier one with the same id. A replaced highlight keeps its position: only a new id goes to the end.

      Here the refused values are the ones the file cannot hold: a comma or a line break inside a field would split its record in two on reload. The refusal comes before the file is read, so a refused highlight leaves the archive exactly as it was.

      Specified by:
      save in interface HighlightRepository
      Parameters:
      highlight - the highlight to keep
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the storage cannot be written
